selection.rationale: Excluded 10-shot pilot informed transition ranges and cost. Same five sizes in both channels. All seven physical-p values per channel form the primary local fit window. X point shards distribute expensive L11 decoding without overlapping points. Independent point streams for every shard and channel.
selection.analysis_note: Numerical policy and selection frozen before production; input validation and presentation may finish without adapting numerical fitting to results. Timings reflect concurrent processes, not isolated performance benchmarks.
